title: Optimization tools for AI agents
description: Open-source Python and Rust optimization: parallel black-box search, LP/MIP, smooth nonlinear solvers, and durable jobs through MCP or a shell.

projects.name: fast-cma-es / fcmaes
projects.summary: Parallel gradient-free optimization for Python: black-box, multi-objective and quality-diversity search.
projects.fit: Python objectives and simulations; parallel retries or population evaluation; CMA-ES, DE, BiteOpt, MODE and MAP-Elites.
projects.limits: Heuristic search, with constraints handled by the selected method. No stock job worker or MCP server in this package.
projects.availability: PyPI: fcmaes. Build from source for changes after the latest release.

projects.name: fcmaes-rust
projects.summary: Native Rust parallel black-box optimization, Python bindings, and a worker for durable optimization jobs.
projects.fit: Rust objectives, parallel global search, Pareto search and quality diversity. Application workers run registered Rust models as jobs.
projects.limits: Python callbacks do not gain native Rust parallelism. The experimental surrogate targets small deterministic continuous-box problems; consult its limits before use.
projects.availability: crates.io: fcmaes-core; PyPI: fcmaes-rust. Job worker and experimental surrogate: source only.

projects.name: LP-IP-craft
projects.summary: Native Rust linear and mixed-integer linear programming with Python bindings and a shell/MCP job worker.
projects.fit: Models with linear objectives and constraints. Libraries take structured models; the job worker accepts a hashed model artifact, with an MPS converter in the repository.
projects.limits: MIP variables need finite bounds, supplied or inferred. No QP/MIQP. Statuses and gaps are numerical findings under tolerances; benchmark hard industrial MIPs against mature solvers.
projects.availability: Source only: Rust crates, Python bindings and lp-ip-job-worker. Registry release workflows are prepared.

projects.name: SQP-craft
projects.summary: Rust sequential quadratic programming for smooth constrained optimization, with Python bindings and a shell/MCP job worker.
projects.fit: Smooth continuous models with gradients and Jacobians, local refinement and multistart. User nonlinear jobs require a registered model in an application worker.
projects.limits: Dense BFGS with at most 256 variables. Local first-order results, not global certificates. For larger sparse NLPs, consider an IPOPT-family solver.
projects.availability: Source only: Rust crates, Python bindings and sqp-job-worker. Registry release workflows are prepared.

projects.name: optimization-jobs
projects.summary: Durable optimization jobs for AI agents: local Rust runner, worker SDK and MCP server with a shared CPU budget.
projects.fit: An agent needs to discover workers, validate, submit, follow or cancel jobs and read results and artifacts through MCP or a shell.
projects.limits: Linux, one local node, cooperative CPU accounting. Install and register workers first. No distributed scheduler or exact optimizer-state resume.
projects.availability: Source only: optimization-job-api and optimization-runner (optimization-run and optimization-mcp). No solver is bundled.
